name: X7 Pro
summary: X7 Pro is DAX Robotics’ wheeled humanoid platform for commercial mobile manipulation. It combines an expressive screen head, two articulated arms, configurable grippers or dexterous hands, and an omnidirectional mobile base. The manufacturer positions it for retail and logistics work, including pharmacy and parcel sorting. It supports teleoperation, software integration and local AI operation; the Pro configuration is promoted for commercial deployment. The exact delivery schedule remains unverified.
